responsibility: Generated NVPTX target support header that defines TARGET_SMxx predicates for each supported streaming-multiprocessor level. The backend includes it from nvptx.h so code in nvptx.cc and related files can write concise architecture-threshold tests against the selected ptx_isa_option without duplicating the SM list.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/nvptx/nvptx-gen.opt, this generated nvptx-gen file is a C header included from nvptx.h that turns supported sm_* levels into TARGET_SMxx preprocessor predicates comparing ptx_isa_option, rather than defining option-table enum entries for parsing -misa= values.
